subject: music
title: Musical Structure
welcome_lead: Verse, chorus, intro and outro — song architecture.
meta_desc: KS3 structure: verse-chorus form, intro, bridge, outro.
final_note: Songs are built like buildings — section by section.

walkthroughs.body_html: A typical pop song goes: Intro - Verse - Chorus - Verse - Chorus - Bridge - Chorus - Outro. The chorus returns and feels familiar; the bridge offers contrast.
Music teachers label sections with letters: A for the first idea, B for the next, etc. Binary = AB. Ternary = ABA. Rondo = ABACADA.
A coda (Italian for tail) is a special ending tag in classical music. In pop, an outro brings the song to a close — often a fade-out.
